aboutHeading: Concept to Completion Landscaping in Brooklyn
aboutText: Luke Theodore Landscaping is a Brooklyn-based landscaping company offering a full design and construction service focused on exceeding client expectations. With years of hands-on experience transforming outdoor spaces across Melbourne's western suburbs, we pride ourselves on excellent workmanship and meticulous attention to detail. Every project uses quality materials and thoughtful design, ensuring your landscape is constructed to the highest standards from concept to completion.
servicesText: From initial concept to final construction, Luke Theodore Landscaping delivers complete outdoor transformations across Brooklyn and Melbourne's west. We specialise in quality materials and thoughtful design tailored to your property.

services.title: Landscape Design
services.desc: Thoughtful, custom landscape designs created to match your vision and Brooklyn property perfectly.

services.title: Garden Construction
services.desc: Expert garden builds from concept to completion using quality materials and proven methods.

services.desc: Entertaining areas, patios and outdoor rooms designed for the Melbourne lifestyle.

services.title: Planting and Soft Landscaping
services.desc: Strategic plant selection and garden beds suited to Brooklyn's soil and climate conditions.

services.title: Retaining Walls and Hardscaping
services.desc: Sturdy retaining walls, paving and hard structures built with precision and lasting durability.

services.desc: Fresh, lush lawns installed to complement your new landscape design perfectly.
